thread:
alyssa_cs: FYI — Aperture POC drove a large spike in the dedicated pool (aperture-ded-01) overnight. Queue depth stayed elevated ~30m. Can infra/sre confirm root cause?

capacity-bot: Auto-report: pool=aperture-ded-01, window=23:40-00:30 UTC, avg_gpu_hours=24.7 (baseline 6.5), peak_queue_depth=39, 95p_token_latency=310ms -> 940ms, error_rate(5m)=3.1% (mostly 429). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/aperture/pool-health

ben_infra: looking now. traces show many very short sessions from their POC harness hitting model reloads each time. KV cache cold after each reload -> heavy tail latency. Not a runaway single job.

rohit_sre: 429s are our request-queue throttle. Autoscaler tried to add capacity but short-lived sessions timed out before becoming healthy. Suggest temporary per-tenant concurrency cap + suggest pre-warm KV and reduce demo parallelism.

sophia_am: they have an investor demo at 10:00 UTC today. risk: medium if attendees see stutters. I'll tell them we're applying fixes.

alyssa_cs: quick plan: 1) soft concurrency cap for 2h, 2) set autoscale policy to conservative for that pool, 3) attempt to reserve 1 slot for demo if available, 4) notify finance of potential overage. agree?

ben_infra: applying cap: `redwoodctl capacity update --tenant aperture --concurrency 7 --window 2h --note "POC spike mitigation"`

```
# run by infra
redwoodctl capacity update --tenant aperture --concurrency 7 --window 2h --note "POC spike mitigation"
```

rohit_sre: switching autoscale to aperture-poc-safe for 2h and monitoring 95p & error rate for 20m.

ops-bot: Action: concurrency cap applied by ben_infra at 1845001225. Autoscale policy set to aperture-poc-safe by rohit_sre at 1845001240.

billing-bot: Billing alert: tenant=aperture, projected overage=$1.1k sent to finance@redwood at 1845001250.

sophia_am: I'll message customer: "Temporary cap and reserve applied, we'll share a 3-bullet checklist before demo." Can someone draft 3 bullets?

alyssa_cs: Draft: 1) reduce demo parallel workers to <=6, 2) prefill KV cache (`prefill_cache=true`) before demo, 3) avoid full model reloads between requests.

ben_infra: 15m post-cap metrics: peak_queue_depth -> 15, 95p_token_latency -> 420ms, error_rate -> 0.6%. trending down.

rohit_sre: opened internal ticket https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-9999 "Aperture POC dedicated pool spike" assigned to ben_infra, priority P2.

ops-bot: CS-9999 created at 1845001320, owner=ben_infra.

sophia_am: I'll join the demo and run through the checklist. also looping in renewal lead if spend moves unexpectedly.

alyssa_cs: summary / next steps: - cap applied (ben) - autoscale safe applied (rohit) - ticket CS-9999 opened (ben) - finance alerted (billing-bot) - customer notified (sophia). check back in 35m for stability update. :white_check_mark:

ben_infra: 35m update -> stable, queue 6-10, 95p ~380-430ms, errors ~0.3%. keeping cap until window expires then we'll follow up in CS-9999.

rohit_sre: if KV-miss still shows on follow-up we'll recommend a short TTL increase on prefill or a lightweight warm endpoint.

alyssa_cs: thanks team. good job moving fast. follow-ups in CS-9999.
